'''Ice Queen's''' is a Secret Portal drop by doing the frozen portal which is currently unobtainable after the Christmas event has ended.

'''Ice Queen's Portal''' can obtained by the following:
{| class="mw-collapsible fandom-table"
|Required Items:
|Frozen Portals
|-
|Result
|Ice Queen's portal (Not Guaranteed From Every Frozen Portal)
|}

* The Drop Chance in a Ice Queen's Portal is 100% for the host and 5% for the other players in the portal 
* The portal Drops a '''''Secret''''' unit "[[Ice Queen]]" Which can be later evolved to"[[Ice Queen (Empire's Strongest)|Ice Queen (Empires strongest)]]"
